kpis.description_fr: Production totale ~730 kBOE/j. Boost 2024 via acquisition Grayson Mill (Bakken). Mix ~50 % huile.
kpis.description_en: Total production ~730 kBOE/d. 2024 boost via Grayson Mill acquisition (Bakken). ~50% oil mix.

kpis.description_fr: Delaware Basin (Permian) = cœur de production Devon. ~65 % du total. Bassin le plus économique USA shale.
kpis.description_en: Delaware Basin (Permian) = Devon's production core. ~65% of total. Most economic US shale basin.

kpis.description_fr: Mix huile / gas / NGLs. ~50 % huile = exposition Brent/WTI maximale. Différence vs gas-weighted peers (EQT, RRC).
kpis.description_en: Oil / gas / NGLs mix. ~50% oil = maximum Brent/WTI exposure. Differs from gas-weighted peers (EQT, RRC).

kpis.description_fr: Cash return = ~70 % du FCF restitué actionnaires (dividend fixe + variable + buybacks). Pionniers du modèle. Discipline capital.
kpis.description_en: Cash return = ~70% of FCF returned to shareholders (fixed + variable dividend + buybacks). Pioneer of model. Capital discipline.

kpis.description_fr: Inventaire puits Tier 1/2 = ~10 ans à rythme actuel. Élargi via Grayson Mill 2024. Visibilité long terme.
kpis.description_en: Tier 1/2 drilling inventory = ~10 years at current pace. Expanded via Grayson Mill 2024. Long-term visibility.
